# Litematica Printer 4th 1.1.1-hotfix.1

This is a targeted hotfix for **Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2**. Minecraft 26.3 is unchanged; continue using its 1.1.1 jar.

## Fixed

When the printer's **Servux hand confirmation** option was on but Litematica's own entity-data sync option was off, newer Litematica releases could silently suppress the metadata and entity requests needed to confirm the server's held item. The printer would then wait for Servux instead of continuing to print.

The printer now keeps Litematica's handler-level entity-data gate open while its hand-confirmation option is enabled. This does **not** change Litematica's saved setting or implement a second network protocol. Litematica still handles the v1/v2 wire format, and the client-side Litematica and server-side Servux versions must use matching protocols. The fix is limited to the 26.1.2 and 26.2 adapters; printing actions and other modes are unchanged.

## Compatibility and verification

| Minecraft | Tested Litematica versions | Servux protocol |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 26.1.2 | 0.27.9 and 0.27.11 | v1 and v2 |
| 26.2 | 0.28.3 and 0.28.5 | v1 and v2 |

- Compiled both hotfix adapters and their GameTest sources locally with JDK 25.
- Ran the client compatibility GameTests for the four Litematica/MaLiLib pairs above, including an assertion that the printer option opens the entity-data gate while Litematica's own option remains off.
- Ran the 26.2 Servux hand-confirmation GameTest against a test-only protocol endpoint for both v1 and v2. With three dropped carried-item packets, the server received all four intended stone blocks, no dirt blocks, and the expected inventory counts.

The test endpoint is not the released Servux mod. This hotfix does not make a v1 client compatible with a v2 server, and it does not change how Servux handles network packet loss. Avoid vulnerable older Servux server builds; see the [upstream security advisory](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/servux/security/advisories/GHSA-4x67-52jx-vr7m).

# 中文说明

本次为 **Minecraft 26.1.2 与 26.2** 的定向修复。26.3 未改动，请继续使用其 1.1.1 jar。

开启打印机的 **Servux 换手确认**、关闭 Litematica 自身的实体数据同步时，新版 Litematica 可能在发送前拦截请求，导致打印机一直等待 Servux。本次让打印机的确认开关同时打开这道发送检查，但不会修改 Litematica 已保存的设置，也没有在打印机内另写一套 v1/v2 协议。客户端 Litematica 与服务端 Servux 仍须协议匹配；具体打印动作及其他模式未变。

已用 JDK 25 编译两个版本，并对 26.1.2 的 Litematica 0.27.9/0.27.11、26.2 的 0.28.3/0.28.5 运行客户端兼容性测试。26.2 的 v1/v2 换手确认测试使用测试专用的 Servux 协议端点：丢弃三个换手包后，服务端仍只得到四个预期的石头方块，没有泥土方块，物品数量也正确。测试端点不等同于正式 Servux 模组；本次不提供 v1 客户端与 v2 服务端的跨协议兼容。
